list.name: customer_id
list.label: Customer
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, name AS __text FROM customers ORDER BY name

list.name: router
list.label: Router
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, identity_name AS __text FROM routers WHERE customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY identity_name

targets.rawSql: SELECT identity_name AS "Router", mgmt_host AS "Mgmt Host", last_seen_at AS "Last Seen", CASE WHEN last_seen_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' THEN 'online' ELSE 'offline' END AS "Status" FROM routers WHERE customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY identity_name

WITH deltas AS (SELECT uplink_label, time, rx_bytes - LAG(rx_bytes) OVER (PARTITION BY uplink_label ORDER BY time) AS rx_delta, tx_bytes - LAG(tx_bytes) OVER (PARTITION BY uplink_label ORDER BY time) AS tx_delta, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY uplink_label ORDER BY time))) AS seconds_elapsed FROM uplink_metrics WHERE router_id = $router AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) AS "time", uplink_label || ' download' AS metric, GREATEST(rx_delta, 0) * 8 / NULLIF(seconds_elapsed, 0) AS value FROM deltas WHERE rx_delta IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time), uplink_label || ' upload', GREATEST(tx_delta, 0) * 8 / NULLIF(seconds_elapsed, 0) FROM deltas WHERE tx_delta IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

WITH deltas AS (SELECT um.router_id, um.uplink_label, um.time, um.rx_bytes - LAG(um.rx_bytes) OVER (PARTITION BY um.router_id, um.uplink_label ORDER BY um.time) AS rx_delta, um.tx_bytes - LAG(um.tx_bytes) OVER (PARTITION BY um.router_id, um.uplink_label ORDER BY um.time) AS tx_delta, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (um.time - LAG(um.time) OVER (PARTITION BY um.router_id, um.uplink_label ORDER BY um.time))) AS seconds_elapsed FROM uplink_metrics um JOIN routers r ON r.id = um.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(um.time)) SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) AS "time", sum(GREATEST(rx_delta, 0) * 8 / NULLIF(seconds_elapsed, 0)) AS "download_bps", sum(GREATEST(tx_delta, 0) * 8 / NULLIF(seconds_elapsed, 0)) AS "upload_bps" FROM deltas WHERE rx_delta IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (pm.router_id, pm.target_name) r.identity_name AS "Router", pm.target_name || ' (' || pm.target_host || ')' AS "Target", pm.rtt_avg_ms AS "Avg RTT (ms)", pm.packet_loss_pct AS "Loss %", pm.time AS "As of" FROM path_metrics pm JOIN routers r ON r.id = pm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id AND pm.target_name IN ('cloudflare-dns', 'google-dns', 'facebook.com', 'google.com') ORDER BY pm.router_id, pm.target_name, pm.time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (dm.router_id, dm.pool_name) r.identity_name AS "Router", dm.pool_name AS "Pool", dm.active_leases AS "Active", dm.total_addresses AS "Total", dm.utilization_pct AS "Util %", dm.time AS "As of" FROM dhcp_pool_metrics dm JOIN routers r ON r.id = dm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY dm.router_id, dm.pool_name, dm.time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (rf.router_id) r.identity_name AS "Router", rf.board_name AS "Model", rf.architecture AS "Arch", rf.routeros_version AS "RouterOS", rf.current_firmware AS "Firmware", rf.upgrade_firmware AS "Available Upgrade", rf.time AS "Checked" FROM router_firmware rf JOIN routers r ON r.id = rf.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY rf.router_id, rf.time DESC

SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', cm.time) AS "time", count(DISTINCT cm.client_mac) AS "clients" FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(cm.time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', cm.time) AS "time", avg(cm.signal) AS "avg_signal", avg(cm.satisfaction) AS "avg_satisfaction" FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(cm.time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (ai.ap_mac) ai.ap_name AS "AP", ai.model AS "Model", ai.version AS "Firmware", ai.cpu_pct AS "CPU %", ai.mem_pct AS "Mem %", ai.channel_util_2g AS "2.4G Util", ai.channel_util_5g AS "5G Util", ai.time AS "As of" FROM ap_inventory ai WHERE ai.site_id IN (SELECT id FROM sites WHERE customer_id = $customer_id) ORDER BY ai.ap_mac, ai.time DESC

SELECT rm.time AS "time", r.identity_name || ' CPU %' AS metric, rm.cpu_load_pct AS value FROM router_metrics rm JOIN routers r ON r.id = rm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(rm.time) UNION ALL SELECT rm.time, r.identity_name || ' RAM %', CASE WHEN rm.ram_total_bytes > 0 THEN 100.0 * rm.ram_used_bytes / rm.ram_total_bytes END FROM router_metrics rm JOIN routers r ON r.id = rm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(rm.time) UNION ALL SELECT rm.time, r.identity_name || ' Disk %', CASE WHEN rm.disk_total_bytes > 0 THEN 100.0 * rm.disk_used_bytes / rm.disk_total_bytes END FROM router_metrics rm JOIN routers r ON r.id = rm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(rm.time) ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) AS "time", core_name AS metric, avg(load_pct) AS value FROM cpu_core_metrics WHERE router_id = $router AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, core_name ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.id AS router_id, r.identity_name AS "Router", cs.time AS "Captured", cs.size_bytes AS "Size (bytes)" FROM router_config_snapshots cs JOIN routers r ON r.id = cs.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY cs.time DESC LIMIT 20
